name: Jackdaw Savior
description: Flying. Whenever Jackdaw Savior or another creature you control with flying dies, return another target creature card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield.
assumptions: Read owner:"me" on the trigger and move nodes as "you control"/"your graveyard" by analogy with the card's other me-owned nodes.
couldNotDerive: Whether the trigger is restricted to flying creatures (the multi-clause ValidCard's .withFlying qualifier isn't read).
The "lesser mana value" and "another" (excluding the dying creature) restrictions on the return target.
notes: Found and fixed a systemic gap: this card's trigger is ChangesZone with Origin$Battlefield/Destination$Graveyard (a rule-700.4 'dies' event), but the trigger-type derivation only special-cased Destination$Battlefield ('enter') -- everything else fell through to the literal, unreadable string mode.toLowerCase() = 'changeszone'. Added the same-shape isDies check (Origin Battlefield + Destination Graveyard) alongside the existing isEnter one, now correctly reads trigger-type:"dies". This is a general fix, not card-specific -- benefits every 'whenever ~ dies' BLB card using ChangesZone/ChangesZoneAll (confirmed it also fixed Scavenger's Talent's base ability in the same batch). Two narrower, card-specific qualifier gaps remain, not fixed: the multi-clause ValidCard's .YouCtrl/.withFlying qualifiers (on "another creature you control with flying") aren't read by qualifierFlags() at all, and the return target's .cmcLTX+YouOwn+NotDefinedTriggeredCard (a mana-value-relative, dynamic-SVar-driven "another, lesser cost" restriction, X = TriggeredCard$CardManaCost) is a real, non-trivial dynamic comparison -- similar in kind to Beza's flagged gap but narrower in scope (comparing to the triggering object's own value, not another player's board state). Left as documented backlog rather than attempted.
